subject: cat
scope: Still-key drawing review only: inspected source-keys.png, design.png and revisions/keys-v1.png at the four source-relative times. No video playback or motion-quality judgment.

exact_key_evidence.evidence: The drawing preserves the chest-up, slightly upward-looking three-quarter view. However, the chosen design has two large empty polygon eye shapes and a blunt polygon face; the drawing replaces these with small lidded eyes, pupils, nose, mouth, forehead stripes and a shaggy contour.
The source has only a small attention change from key 0. The drawing appropriately stays close to key 0 rather than inventing a new action.
The source remains nearly in the same upward-looking pose. The third drawing also remains close, with a slightly altered lid/head angle.
The clear turn toward screen right is present; the muzzle projects rightward and the far eye narrows to a sliver. This is a distinct source-motivated change, not an unrelated expression.

main_gap: The action is reasonably preserved, but the actual selected QuickDraw identity is not strongly recognizable. The set is a consistent, more conventional tabby cartoon rather than an articulated version of the supplied sparse polygon-face doodle.
one_bounded_repair: Restyle the four existing head poses using the selected design’s blunt polygon head, large empty asymmetric polygon eyes and sparse whisker lines; remove the added tabby facial detailing while keeping the present pose angles and final rightward turn.
protected_strengths: Keep the restrained differences between keys 0–2.
Keep the chest-up framing and the clear rightward turn at key 3.
Keep one consistent head construction across the set.
